p.s: Dear Jane Clark
I am writing to tell you about the festival in this time and I would like to suggest you three things for next festival.
First of all, it is great idea to have a this kind of festival.
I enjoyed it so much.
But, there are three things which I would like to tell you.
Firstly.
There were stars and artists from only six countries.
I supposed to see quite various nationality.
Secondly, I actually liked Jazz, rock and classical concerts very much.
However, some concert halls were too small for the many people so we couldn't have a enough space.
thirdly.
I would like to you to consider about having more plays and films next year.
It would be nicer.
Otherwise, the price was really reasonable for all :events the weekend.
I was satisfied with that.
And if there was musical event.
It would be greatful.
I hope the next one will be better.
And I would like to thank you about making this festival.
I look forward to next festival very much.
Yours sincerely
